title: Goodwill Share of a Late Fee by Twelve-Month Payment Record
content:
For goodwill relief on a late fee on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, the late fee is multiplied by a goodwill share that follows the borrower's record over the 12 whole months before the request date, counting the late fees assessed and the payments returned in that window, as the loan history shows them.

## Decision table

| Late fees assessed in the window | Payments returned in the window | Goodwill share of the late fee |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | at least one | returned-history goodwill share: 0.25 |
| two or more | none | late-history goodwill share: 0.5 |
| fewer than two | any | the full late fee |

## Reading the window

An entry counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its date from the request date. Hypothetical, request on 2026-04-30: a late fee assessed on 2025-05-01 is 11 whole months back and counts; one assessed on 2025-04-30 is 12 whole months back and does not. The late fee being relieved is itself one of the late fees counted when it falls in the window.

## Worked figures (hypothetical late fee of 24.00)

| Record in the window | Share | Late fee times share |
|---|---|---|
| 3 late fees, 1 returned payment | 0.25 | 6.00 |
| 2 late fees, no returned payment | 0.5 | 12.00 |
| 1 late fee, 2 returned payments | full | 24.00 |
